thread:
Sara: quick sync — we need to lock the co-sell private offer for the appliance + reserved commit. target launch week of Aug 7. main asks: commit tiers, HW credit, and renewal language. any blockers?
Miguel: can we land on numbers today? sales needs a digest to share with partners.
Aline: propose 3-tier discount: 25k, 75k, 250k commit. larger commit gets HW credit + 6mo renewal discount.
Tom: +1 on tiers. need to confirm SI uplift — they want at least a 10% attach credit for onboarding services.
Jamie: legal flag — minimum contract term and auto-renew opt-in. we should avoid perpetual discounts on renewals; prefer step-down renewal credits.
Sara: noted. also want to keep private offer SKU mapping simple so marketplace listings don't get 100 SKUs. aim for 3 SKUs: base, bundle, enterprise.
Miguel: sample pricing snippet for the pitch deck:```
Tier A (25k): 12% off hosted, no HW credit
Tier B (75k): 20% off hosted, $10k HW credit
Tier C (250k): 28% off hosted, $40k HW credit + 6mo renewal at 15%
```
Aline: can we add an early-adopter addendum: 90-day usage ramp guarantee and ability to convert unused commit to credits for next year? that helps close bigger deals.
Tom: SI ops: need a clear onboarding rebate flow. suggested flow: 1) bill customer, 2) SI submits MSA + onboarding ticket, 3) ops issues rebate within 45 days.
Sara: marketplace-bot — pull the private offer doc and example contract snippet please.
marketplace-bot: here's the private-offer checklist: https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/private-offers (includes SKU mapping, offering.json example, and renewal clause templates) :link:
Jamie: thanks — from legal POV we should template renewal language like: `renewal_discount = max(original_discount - 5%, minimum 5%)` so discounts taper.
Miguel: sales ask — can we make the HW credit claim process self-serve via partner portal? reduces ops load.
Tom: SI will still need proof-of-work attachments; portal can accept attachments and auto-queue rebate. works for us.
Aline: marketing note — plan joint announcement three weeks after launch to give partners time to onboard customers. co-branding assets ready by T-14 days.
Sara: action items: (1) Aline finalize promo + joint announcement cadence, (2) Miguel finalize pricing deck for partners, (3) Jamie lock renewal clause + min term, (4) Tom & eng infra scope partner portal intake, (5) ops to draft rebate SLA.
Miguel: i'll circulate a one-pager in the channel by EOD.
Jamie: legal will review and post redlines tomorrow.
Aline: will schedule a 30-min partner ops walkthrough Friday.
Sara: perfect. thanks all :raised_hands: — let's aim to publish the offer to marketplace QA by next Tues.
Tom: noted. will sync SI enablement docs.
marketplace-bot: deploy-checklist reminder: `private-offer -> QA -> publish -> announce`. next reminder in 48h.
Sara: closing loop here — post any new asks into this thread so we keep history tied to the offer.
